newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 posts biggest one day gain this year.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 posts biggest one day gain this year.

text.p: The British stock market on Friday swept aside worries over next Tuesday's budget and lingering fears of rising interest rates to chalk up its biggest one day gain this year amid a sudden turnaround in sentiment.

"It's incredible how quickly sentiment can change," said one senior trader. "We were expecting shares to be squeezed up because everyone was keeping positions so tight in front of the budget, but we never anticipated getting back through 4,000."
The FTSE 100 index has been unable to regain ground above 4,000 since an unexpected rise in UK base rates last month. The index closed 64.9 points higher today at 4,018.7.
